title: hoa.fx.convolve~
description: `hoa.fx.convolve~` provides HiFi-LoFi convolution reverberation for HOA signals, using a table name argument for the impulse response and wet, dry, and normalization attributes. It can use a different impulse response for each harmonic for decorrelation or operate in the plane-wave domain; avoid large impulse responses and high HOA orders because the convolution is not sufficiently optimized.
